void.description: This function does not return anything.

tile_layer_prop_count.description: Get the number of custom properties on a layer of a tilemap.

tile_draw_layer_on_image.description: Draw a single layer of a tilemap on an image.

tile_layer_image.description: Render a single layer of a tilemap to a new image.

tile_get_tile.description: Get the gid of the tile at a column/row in a tilemap layer.

tile_set_tile.description: Set the gid of the tile at a column/row in a tilemap layer. Swapping a gid is how a cart keeps changing state in the map itself.

tile_draw_tile.description: Draw a single tile from a tilemap on the screen.

tile_image.description: Get a copy of the image of a single tile in a tilemap.

tile_gid_prop.description: Get a custom property of a tile of a tilemap, by name (PROP_NONE when there is no such property.) These come from the tileset, so every tile with this gid shares them.

tile_gid_prop_count.description: Get the number of custom properties on a tile of a tilemap.

tile_gid_prop_at.description: Get a custom property of a tile of a tilemap, by index (PROP_NONE when out of range.)

tile_object_count.description: Get the number of objects on an object-layer of a tilemap.

tile_object.description: Get an object from an object-layer of a tilemap.

tile_object_index.description: Get the index of an object on an object-layer of a tilemap, by name (-1 when there is no such object.)

tile_object_prop.description: Get a custom property of an object of a tilemap, by name (PROP_NONE when there is no such property.)

tile_object_prop_count.description: Get the number of custom properties on an object of a tilemap.

tile_object_prop_at.description: Get a custom property of an object of a tilemap, by index (PROP_NONE when out of range.)

delta_time.description: Get the change in time (seconds) since the last update run.

random_int.description: Get a random integer between 2 numbers.

js.title: JavaScript
notes: The API is plain globals - nothing to import. Callbacks are ESM exports of `main.js`.
Structs are plain objects (`{ r: 0, g: 121, b: 241, a: 255 }`); array args know their own length, so you never pass the count.
`std` and `os` from QuickJS are available as globals, as is WASI.
Drop `null0.d.ts` + `jsconfig.json` next to `main.js` for editor completion and typechecking.
